jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

We're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide, inspire, and work alongside a dedicated team of warehouse professionals while ensuring operational excellence in our fast-paced international logistics environment.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standards

Operational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processes

Hands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when needed

Performance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiatives

Critical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situations

Safety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all times

Reporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational management

Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Essential Requirements:

3+ years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environments

Forklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)

Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)

Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlines

Physical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feet

Flexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekends

Problem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experience

Experience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)

Knowledge of customs procedures and international shipping

Lean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experience

Multilingual capabilities for our international client base

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 

• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scanners

Quality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processing

Packing & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labeling

Receiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systems

Inventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanliness

Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environment

Team Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shifts

Continuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:
Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learn

Enthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!

Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on you

Eye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operations

Physical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shift

Availability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)

Basic Dutch or English communication skills

What Makes You Stand Out:

Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipment

Forklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)

Previous experience in international logistics or port operations

Multilingual skills for our diverse, international workplace

Positive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

Do you have experience as a forklift driver?As the driver of the forklift truck with long forks, you are responsible for storing goods and loading/unloading the trucks. In addition, you sometimes help with other tasks in the warehouse (order picking, receiving, stock counting, etc.). For this, you will use a scanner.You will start in the Katoen Natie warehouses in Ghent.

Profile

• You have experience with a forklift truck with long forks (2m40) or you have extensive experience with a forklift truck with short forks and you see yourself driving the long-fork truck as well.

• A forklift certificate is not a requirement, experience is more important. There will be a theoretical and practical test

• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, you speak and understand Dutch or English well.

• You can work in a two-shift system

• You are motivated and reliable, and you prize safety and quality.

• You are flexible when it comes to hours and tasks

• In addition, you know how to use a scanner and a computer

As a reach truck driver, you are one of the most important links in the Katoen Natie warehouse in Ghent. You are responsible for storing and preparing valuable materials. Using the reach truck, you regularly stock goods on high racks. This requires an eye for detail and safety.

 

Profile

• Physical work doesn't put you off, you like to roll up your sleeves

• You work 60% on the reachtruck and 40% other tasks in the warehouse

• You ideally have extensive experience with the reach truck (at least 1 year); a certificate is a plus, but not a must

• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, it is important that you speak and understand Dutch or English or French

• You start in a day shift for training and then fulltime night shift

You are responsible for repairs or maintenance work on industrial vehicles, such as waste trucks, special trucks for abroad and so on.

All those vehicles are build by us.

This includes full diagnosis, maintenance, repair of claims, ...

• Experience as a mechanic or passion to work on vehicles

• You are handy and you are passionate about technology

• school leaver car mechanics is certainly possible

• Dutch or English

Put on your work shoes and kickstart your career in the ice cream industry! 

Are you a go-getter with a heart for quality? At Jacques IJs in Oevel (Westerlo), a proud 100% independent family-owned business, the most delicious ice creams, sorbets, and popsicles roll off the production line for the entire European market.

We are not looking for numbers, but for motivated colleagues who want to grow with us in a modern, pleasant production environment (no freezing cold temperatures!).

Send your CV to talentcenter4@randstad.be or apply directly. Our AI-agent will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few quick screening questions, and our consultant will follow up on your application.

VG458/BUOSAP

Have you worked in a production or packaging environment before? That first experience is a big plus! But above all, we are looking for the right mindset:

• Drive: You are accurate, involved, and ready to roll up your sleeves.
• Ambition to grow: You are someone who wants to eventually grow into roles such as Operator or Line Supervisor.
• Flexibility: Working the night shift is ideal for you.
• Communication: You speak English well enough to ensure safe cooperation on the work floor.
• Mobility: You have your own transport (car, scooter, or bicycle), as the site in Oevel is difficult to reach by public transport.
As a Production Worker / Packer, you are the final, crucial link. You make sure every ice cream leaves the factory in perfect condition:

• Accurate packing: You pack various ice cream products according to the highest standards.
• Quality check: You have an eagle eye and check if all labels and packaging are 100% correct.
• Team spirit: You support your colleagues and keep the production line running smoothly.
• Ready for shipment: You cross the t's and dot the i's so that all of Europe can enjoy our ice creams.

Do you melt for ice cream? The sweetest challenge in Westerlo awaits you!

Forget about chilly factory environments where you are just a number. At Jacques IJs in Oevel (Westerlo) it's all about a great atmosphere, amazing taste, and teamwork. We produce the most delicious ice creams, sorbets, and water ice for the entire European market. And don't worry: you won't need to wear a heavy winter coat. Our modern production area has a very comfortable temperature; we leave the freezing cold inside the freezers!

Because we are growing rapidly, we are looking for a Production Worker / Packer with passion, energy, and above all: the ambition to grow with us.

Send your CV to talentcenter4@randstad.be or apply directly. Our AI-agent will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few quick screening questions, and our consultant will follow up on your application.

VG458/BUOSAP

Do you already have experience in a production environment? Great! If not? No problem at all, your mindset is what matters most.

• You want to move forward: Today you start at the packing line, but you dream of growing into an Operator or Line Manager role. We will give you that opportunity!
• Flexible mindset: Working in a 2-shift system fits your lifestyle perfectly.
• Accurate & driven: You know how to work hard, but you never lose sight of the details.
• Fluent in English: Good communication with your colleagues is essential for a safe and smooth workflow.
• Mobile: You have your own car, scooter, or bicycle (unfortunately, our site in Oevel is very difficult to reach by public transport).

You are the crucial final link before our creations head out into the world. Your mission:

• Masterful packing: You ensure that every ice cream comes off the conveyor belt neatly and securely packed.
• The eagle eye: Quality is king! You do lightning-fast checks to ensure all labels and packaging are 100% correct.
• The engine of the line: Together with your colleagues, you keep the energy high and the machines running smoothly.
• Ready for departure: You prepare the finished products for shipment, ensuring that all of Europe can enjoy our ice cream soon.

For Capgemini/Sogeti, located in Diegem, we are currently hiring for this position.
 

As a

For the maintenance department of our client located in Grimbergen, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work rotating shifts (6:00-14:00 and 14:00-22:00).

This role requires strong technical knowledge, hands-on problem-solving skills, and a commitment to safety. You will troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and respond promptly to repair requests.

Your main responsibilities as a Maintenance Technician:

• Maintain and repair automated systems as needed

• Perform maintenance and repairs on lift trucks

• Conduct electrical and mechanical maintenance on all equipment and installations

• Service and maintain order pickers, reach trucks, and combi trucks

The Maintenance Technician we are looking for possesses the following qualities:

• Engineering background

• Ability to work rotating shifts (6h-14h and 14h-22h)

• Hands-on and dynamic approach

• Precision and results-oriented mindset

• Takes initiative and assumes responsibility

• Team player who can also work independently

jobs.occupation: Warehouse Operator / Reach Truck Driver – 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Are you someone who enjoys working in a warehouse and likes a varied working day? Do you have experience operating a reach truck, but also enjoy getting hands-on with order picking and other warehouse activities? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Your responsibilities

As a Warehouse Operator, you play an important role in the logistics process. You ensure that goods are handled, moved and prepared for shipment correctly and efficiently.

Your duties will include:

• Picking orders and preparing them for shipment.

• Receiving and checking incoming goods.

• Storing products in the correct warehouse locations.

• Moving goods and pallets using a reach truck, for both inbound and outbound operations.

• Occasionally loading and unloading trucks using a forklift.

• Labelling products and registering them correctly in the system.

• Maintaining a clean, safe and well-organised working environment.

 

Your profile

We are looking for someone who enjoys a varied warehouse role and is flexible when it comes to different tasks.

In addition, you meet the following requirements:

• You have initial work experience as a reach truck operator.

• You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English, both spoken and written.

• You are comfortable working with numbers and counting accurately.

• You are available to start at short notice.

• You are willing to perform various warehouse tasks, including operating the reach truck, order picking and checking goods.

• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

For our client, a niche player within the metal sector, we are looking for a welder on the night shift.

Furthermore, you will perform first-line maintenance on the machine.

For our client in Tielt, specialized in recycling foam materiales is looking for an extra co-worker.

Tasks:

- setting up and starting the machine

- quality control

- discharge and supply of raw materials with forklift truck

- keeping work area tidy

- You have experience driving a forklift

- You have no physical complaints

- Working in 2 shifts.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

As Test Automation Engineer, you’ll join an enthusiastic multidisciplinary team at our HQ in Brussels to develop qualitative applications in a fast-changing IT landscape. jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Risk Specialist – HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our ‘Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)’ team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.

jobs.occupation: Web Content Management Engineer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Agile Production Services (APS) tribe is where IT Production happens. As part of a tight-knit group of 7 teams, we handle end-to-end Production Services, from go-live support to 24/7 on-call troubleshooting (yes, nights and weekends included).

Your role? The tech backbone of our digital operations. Whether it’s Level 2/3 support, application security, or hosting optimization, you’ll work closely with Infrastructure and Dev teams to keep our systems fast, secure, and reliable. No two days are the same - and that’s the way we like it.

AND IN DETAIL

As our WCM Specialist, you’ll be the go-to person for all things Web Content Management. 

That means:

• Ownership of WCM expertise: you’ll be the resident guru on TeamSite, headless architecture, and best practices. When teams need answers, they come to you.
• Building, integrating, improving: you’ll analyze, develop, or implement new components, working with Application Leads and integrators to push boundaries. 
• Keeping the Portal running smoothly: but not just maintaining it. You’ll help shape the future vision in our WCM guild (our tech community).
• Documentation that actually helps: you’ll turn complex setups into clear, actionable guides for stakeholders. No jargon-heavy manuals.
• Collaborating with architects: you’ll assist in cost-benefit analyses for new web implementations. 
• Security and performance first: you’ll play an active role in incident, problem, and change management. Finding issues, fixing them, preventing repeats.
• Setting standards: you’ll ensure every user, on every device, has a seamless experience.
• Monitoring and optimizing: you’ll track performance, spot bottlenecks, and keep things running at peak efficiency.
• On-call duty: One week per month (18:00–7:30), you’re the go-to person. But don’t worry: you’re never alone.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

What you bring:

• 5+ years of experience.
• OpenText mastery: you know TeamSite, LiveSite, OpenDeploy inside out, in an Agile/XP environment.
• Your tech toolkit:
• JavaScript, Node.js, NPM, React, Webpack, Jest, SASS, HTML5 are your daily drivers.
• CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Nexus). You automate like it’s second nature.
• Headless WCM architecture (especially TeamSite). You don’t just understand it, you make it work.
• Sharp analytical skills. You spot problems before they happen.
 

How you work:

• Team player, but self-driven: you take initiative and own your work.
• Fast learner: new tools? You pick them up quickly and put them to use.
• Open-minded and adaptable: change is the only constant in tech, and you thrive in it.
• Detail-oriented, but big-picture aware: you follow processes without losing sight of the end goal.
• Clear communicator: whether it’s tech talk with devs or updates for management, you get your point across.
• Persistent and committed: you don’t quit until the job’s done right.
• Comfortable in a multicultural environment: different backgrounds, one shared mission.
 

Languages:

• Fluent English (written and spoken) is a must.
• Dutch and/or French? A definite plus.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the guardian of data quality making sure the information we rely on is accurate, reliable, and ready to power everything from seamless customer experiences to cutting-edge digital solutions. Think of it as being the detective, the problem-solver, and the strategist all in one, working with teams across the bank to keep our data in top shape.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As a Client Data Quality Analyst, here’s what your day could look like:

• Spot the gaps, fix the flaws. You’ll design and monitor data quality controls, using dashboards to track how well our systems are performing. 
• Turn data into a strategic advantage. You won’t just be fixing problems, you’ll be helping us use data smarter. That could mean:
• Upgrading dashboards so they give clearer, more actionable insights.
• Documenting metadata so everyone understands what our data means and how to use it.
• Supporting data certification and joining key committees to ensure we’re meeting the highest standards.
• Sharing your know-how with the wider Data Quality team, so we all keep getting better.
• Be the bridge between data and real-world impact You’ll get to know our client data flows and applications inside out, becoming the go-to person. Your work will directly help us improve customer experiences, streamline processes, and stay ahead in a fast-changing industry.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

We’re looking for someone who:

•  Loves solving puzzles. You see data as more than numbers; it’s a story waiting to be uncovered. Experience in data quality analysis (especially in banking) is a big plus.
• Speaks “data” fluently. You understand data lifecycles, governance, and how data drives decisions. You’ve done analysis that shows real business impact and you’re passionate about digital transformation.
• Is tech-savvy (but not a coding genius). You’re comfortable with tools like Excel, MS Access, PowerPoint, and Business Objects. If you’ve worked with Collibra, Ab Initio, Tableau, SQL, or Python, even better, but what matters most is your curiosity and willingness to learn.
• Communicates clearly and collaborates easily. You can explain complex ideas in simple terms (in French, Dutch, or English). You’re a team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and learning from others.
• Thrives on challenges. You don’t shy away from tricky problems. Instead, you roll up your sleeves, ask the right questions, and push for solutions that actually work.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Data department builds and maintains both future-ready and traditional data platforms, tools, and services to ensure easy, secure data access. It empowers data consumers with self-service capabilities while upholding governance and quality standards.

The department delivers scalable, compliant, and user-centric data solutions to meet business needs. Within this framework, the Tribe designs and implements structured, optimized data stores for APIs, reporting, and analytics. They ensure compliance, security, and governance of data assets through modern data management practices, supported by high-quality documentation and tooling. Their mission is to enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed data consumption across the organization.

At BNP Paribas Fortis, you will contribute to innovation by designing advanced data pipelines and infrastructure that power AI, real-time analytics, and strategic decision-making as part of our digital transformation. 

As a Data Engineer, you will address challenges such as scalability, latency, and compliance, ensuring secure, high-quality data flows while collaborating in Agile teams. Your work will unlock data-driven insights, combining technical excellence with regulatory requirements to shape the bank’s future.

The Tribe Data Services comprises over 160 colleagues, organized into more than 10 squads, primarily based in Brussels, with some team members working nearshore or offshore.

AND IN DETAIL

As a Functional Data Engineer, you will:

• Build and maintain optimized data stores by designing, developing, and ensuring well-structured, high-performance data assets (e.g., databases) tailored for APIs, reporting, analytics, and BI tools.
• Enable data-driven decision-making by delivering reliable, accurate, and accessible data for business intelligence, reporting, and analysis services while maintaining related infrastructure.
• Collaborate with internal clients and teams as a trusted partner, understanding stakeholder needs, guiding them on data solutions, and working cross-functionally while adhering to Tribe methodologies and standards.
• Ensure compliance and risk management by strictly following data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR) and banking security policies, mitigating risks in data collection, processing, and storage to safeguard client and institutional data.
• Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, efficiency, and innovation—whether through new tools, automation, or process optimizations—while aligning with business and regulatory requirements.
• Collect the data from the source and design it into models that will be used by developers.  In this role you are the bridge between the business needs and the developers. You translate requests into models that will be interpreted by the developers.
• Uphold data quality and governance by implementing validation rules, monitoring, and metadata management to maintain accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
• Support stakeholders and troubleshoot issues by resolving data incidents (e.g., broken pipelines, latency problems) and partnering with analysts, product owners, or business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions—such as creating self-service datasets or optimizing queries for reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Education and experience:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
• Equivalent experience: minimum 3 years.  
• Hard skills:
• Working experience with databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL.
• Knowledge of SQL, including writing complex queries and performance tuning.
• Profound Knowledge of data warehouse (DWH) modeling (e.g., Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault).
• Understanding or knowledge of ETL tools like Informatica PowerCenter.
• Understanding of Big Data technologies such as Spark, Astronomer.
• Extended knowledge of PowerDesigner tool (or equivalent)  
• Soft skills:
• Problem-solving mindset: ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and propose scalable solutions.
• Collaboration: strong team player with experience in cross-functional Agile teams.
• Ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for data quality, delivery timelines, and system reliability.
• Communication: ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Continuous learning: stays updated on emerging data technologies.  
• Languages:
• You communicate fluently in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset.

Responsibilities

• Organize and maintain the annual calendar for governance cycles to ensure alignment across multiple organizational units.
• Prepare governance meetings by managing agendas, invitations, and logistics while compiling materials from various contributors.
• Coordinate working groups and task forces by drafting minutes and tracking the implementation of follow-up actions.
• Monitor and maintain reporting tools and documentation platforms to ensure data integrity and up-to-date information sharing.
• Propose and implement practical improvements to workflows and administrative processes using automation and innovative tools.
• Provide comprehensive organizational support for workshops, planning sessions, and internal communication routines.

Requirements

• You have 1+ years of experience in project coordination, PMO support, office management, or a comparable administrative role.
• You possess proficiency in Microsoft 365 including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, and Planner.
• You bring strong organizational skills with an emphasis on accuracy, detail, and reliable follow-through on deadlines.
• You possess clear writing skills to capture complex decisions and actions in concise minutes.
• You have strong interpersonal skills to build trust and work effectively with various stakeholders like Product Managers and Leads.
• You are proactive and solution-oriented with a focus on improving existing documentation and follow-up processes.
• You are fluent in English with a good level of Dutch and/or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Confluence or Airfocus.
• Exposure to governance cycles, OKRs, portfolio reviews, or product-roadmap management.
• Previous experience organizing workshops or events within a complex, product-oriented environment.
• Affinity with AI tools to simplify and automate recurring administrative tasks.

Our partner, a company in the financial sector, is looking for a Python Developer with an interest in React.

Our partner is one of the major players in the global financial industry. They operate across all continents and have offices in every major city.

Today, this organization aims to develop in-house software to digitalize the Tax department.

You will have the opportunity to grow within an international company and play a strategic role in this digitalization project.
Python Developer – The Role:
You will be responsible for developing internal applications and will take full ownership of this project from scratch. Your responsibilities will include:

• Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and maintainability of the automation infrastructure.
• Integrating auditability and data protection from the design phase (structured logs, restart capabilities, access controls).
• Contributing to a culture of continuous improvement, transparency, and knowledge sharing.
• Optimizing Python RPA scripts for tax processes.
• Designing and building dashboards based on React.
Python Developer – The Profile:
• You have between 5 and 10 years of experience in Python development.
• You have initial experience in React development.
• You are familiar with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD.
